description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Flare of Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
